decisions.reason: As a recent launch that builds directly on the firm’s established airfield systems and fits its public push toward integrated, automated airport operations, management would be inclined to continue backing it absent clear failure evidence.

Because the product is newly introduced, publicly visible, supported by the firm’s R&D orientation, and consistent with its move toward real-time information sharing and intelligent operations, management would likely retain it and attribute any early weakness to normal market-development delays.
